howto.name: Upload the corrupt PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB that won't open or shows errors in your viewer.

howto.name: PrivaTools rebuilds the file structure
howto.text: Uses pikepdf to parse the PDF tolerantly, recover damaged cross-reference tables, and rewrite the file with a clean structure.

howto.name: Download the repaired PDF
howto.text: Most viewer-breaking issues (broken xref, missing trailer, corrupted streams) are fixable.

faq.q: What kinds of damage can it fix?
faq.a: Missing or corrupt cross-reference tables, broken trailers, dangling object references, slightly-truncated streams. Cannot recover from missing object data.

faq.q: Will the repaired PDF look identical?
faq.a: Yes if the damage was in metadata/structure. Visible content damage (cropped images, missing fonts) requires the original to fix.

faq.q: Can it merge two damaged PDFs?
faq.a: Repair each separately first, then use Merge.
